svg.text: Retention: drop old binders, keep their summaries
Practice 6 with 120 days of test data (June 22 → October 20) · add_retention_policy(…, drop_after => INTERVAL '90 days')
by the retention job (1001), once a day
the summary clerk's window: the last 3 days,
Jul 22 binder (the boundary): still holds readings younger than 90 days, so it waits its turn until tomorrow
summaries kept: hourly averages from June 22 to today
retention only applies to readings; the summary book isn't dropped with it
the summaries survived: their number didn't change
run AFTER retention has worked recomputes every hour
from the raw data. The old raw data is already dropped, so the old
summaries are deleted too (on the lab laptop: 721 went down to 16).
Safe: a window fully within 90 days, for example the start now() - INTERVAL '8 days'.
